The second motivation overlaps with the first; any full-spectral analysis should enable analyses to accommodate down-scatter and/or Compton continuums as part of the background of a lower- energy spectral feature. This advancement would mitigate the effect in existing SDF algorithms where a higher-energy source effectively masks lower energy sources. A competent SDF system operator can presently mitigate masking through inspection of time-dependent spectra, but automating such analyses would be useful and critical for autonomous systems. Additionally, in scenarios where the masking agent spatially interferes with the radiological signature of concern, improved handling of masking sources would improve sensitivity and quantitative performance.
